delistService().details: Only the agent themselves can delist. Suspended agents      cannot delist — the slash authority must reinstate first.

increaseStake(uint256).details: More stake signals higher commitment and improves reputation score.

listService(uint256,uint256,uint8,bytes3.details: The agent must approve this contract to spend their USDC first.      Stake is locked for as long as the listing is active.

recordCall(address,bool).details: Updates the agent's success/failure counters which feed      into the reputation score calculation.

reinstateService(address).details: Only the slash authority can reinstate — prevents self-reinstatement.

slashStake(address,address,uint256,strin.details: Only the slash authority (SentinelGate) can call this.      70% goes to the harmed buyer, 30% to the protocol treasury.      If the slash amount exceeds the stake, we slash everything.

params.buyer: Who was harmed — receives 70% of the slash.

delistService().notice: Delist a service and withdraw the full stake.

increaseStake(uint256).notice: Add more stake to an active listing.

listService(uint256,uint256,uint8,bytes3.notice: List a service on the marketplace by staking USDC.

recordCall(address,bool).notice: Record the outcome of a service call.

reinstateService(address).notice: Reinstate a suspended agent after they have topped up their stake.

slashStake(address,address,uint256,strin.notice: Slash an agent's stake for malicious or failed service.
